to.name: Berkeley Internet Name Domain implementation lineage

property: Berkeley implements the distributed hierarchical DNS design as Unix name-server and resolver software, making zones, replication, queries and application integration concrete operating-system artifacts.

sources.locator: UCB/CSD-84-182 report abstract and design context
sources.supports: BIND implementation of distributed hierarchical naming in Unix and application/mail relevance

negative_claims: BIND is not the DNS protocol itself.
The Berkeley implementation did not invent all DNS namespace concepts.
Server-daemon history and resolver-library history should not be collapsed.
open_questions: Recover earliest BIND source and map RFC compatibility by release.
notes: Implementation-of-architecture lineage; exact relation vocabulary may later be expanded with an explicit implements relation.
